summary: Actual opt-in AgentHost completes one received Next/Choose phase: physical LlmPlanner investigation and fresh admission, event-only physical CLEF control, exact bound local request once, and newer matching same-open received UI progress.

mechanical_contract.before_request: Fresh actionable producer receipt and current PlanLifecycle validation before emission; host-local current client/wire/session references and exact queued action/version/CLEF authorization plus current review deadline before perform; existing bound primitive performs its unchanged one-clock, single-snapshot exact binding/request path.
mechanical_contract.after_request: A matching issued local receipt installs waiting, distinct from pre-send ready observation. Validated current typed UI/controller lease sustains only this admitted phase. Newer matching actor/map/epoch/opening UI can record received UI progress; expired plan/UI, denied/failed/missing local dispatch, unrelated/same-sequence/unsupported UI cannot.
mechanical_contract.local_disposition: PlayingClient additive read-only LocalNpcDispatch says issued/denied/failed only. perform_native and legacy primitives retain None return/signatures. No receipt is a server ACK.
mechanical_contract.binding: NpcHostBinding holds owner-local client/wire/session object references. ScheduledAgent invalidates before connect/start/close and on changed binding before capture/dispatch. Queued actions are exact owner-emitted objects. Prior claimed workers remain owned until join; unclaimed work is cancelled before provider dispatch. Identical metadata does not restore old authority.
mechanical_contract.clef: Once-per-admitted-version received-UI review and allowed execution events, deduplicated by bounded header/version keys. Pending first review holds; continue never authors a menu. Hold/replan pauses requests; bounded LLM replanning uses existing lifecycle policy. No per-tick decision/model loop.
mechanical_contract.captured_context: Existing deep job capture unchanged. NPC execution request includes full captured permitted UI and current complete typed receipt within the unchanged 32768-byte budget. Administrative event keys do not duplicate UI text. Character/public rules/private memory remain advisory; host labels are not native authority.
mechanical_contract.completion: Exactly one response per admitted version; no same-intent retry and no automatic answer to subsequent prompts. A fresh explicit bounded LLM plan/decision can respond to new UI without inheriting the old issued barrier.
mechanical_contract.known_boundary: Standalone approved NpcRespond primitive remains continuous-session only and its cross-instance complete-tuple collision is not claimed fixed. The new host binding policy prevents prior host-owned intent from crossing replacement. UI progress is not native causality, quest success, reward or server closure.
